source_caption_text:
How you start the morning properly 😮‍💨🔥

“Major” by Young Dolph featuring Key Glock is one of those tracks that perfectly captures the energy of their early chemistry. Released in 2018 as the lead single from Dolph’s Role Model album, the song comes in with booming production and confident deliveries from both artists.

The official music video matches that energy with luxury cars, flashy visuals, and the larger-than-life style that became closely associated with Dolph and Key Glock. Dolph brings his signature confidence, while Glock adds a sharp and aggressive verse that keeps the momentum going from start to finish.

“Major” also represents an important part of the Paper Route Empire sound and the duo’s history together. Their chemistry feels completely natural throughout the track, making it one of those collaborations that still hits years later.
